I invite you to the discharge, will you come?
I will try to come, did you want something else?

You understand yourself, I need one last night out.
Have you even assembled the crib for the baby?
What did you think, that she would sleep on the floor?
An hour ago Tatyana stopped by here.
Here are the keys, go and assemble the crib.
Chef, I called, she does not pick up the phone.
Maxim, get going, I still have work to do.

lines.trans: Understood everything, thank you, Chef.

meanings.note: 'брать' alone often means this, in talk about officials

examples.trans: We have to take all the money.
All right, here you go. There, look.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.
So I'm inviting everyone to the discharge!
I'm inviting you to the discharge, will you come?

гульнуть.gloss: to go on a spree, to party

meanings.en: to go on a spree, to have a fling

examples.trans: You understand, I need one last fling.

examples.text: В пятницу мы решили гульнуть всей кухней.
examples.trans: On Friday the whole kitchen decided to go out and party.

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.
Any day now, on the website.
We could open a salon for you.

examples.text: Для вас можно открыть салон красоты.
examples.trans: We could open a beauty salon for you.

meanings.note: affectionate form of дочь; also used by older people to address a young woman

examples.text: Мой Гриша мечтать об этом не мог! Спасибо, дочка!
examples.trans: My Grisha could not even dream of this! Thank you, dear!

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

ехать.gloss: to go (by vehicle), to drive, to ride

meanings.en: to go, to drive, to ride
meanings.note: by car, bus, train, in one direction, now

examples.trans: Vitalik, we're going to the Santa Fe.

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

meanings.note: in threats: ты ещё увидишь = you'll see

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: забирать деньги = to take the money
забирать детей из школы = to pick the kids up from school

examples.trans: I pick the children up from school.

examples.text: А я тебе делаю условный срок. Плюс ты забираешь все деньги Вики.
examples.trans: And I get you a suspended sentence. Plus you take all of Vika's money.

examples.text: Позвони мне вечером. Договоримся на завтра.
examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.

заезжать.gloss: to move in; to drop by

meanings.en: to drop in, to call by (driving)

examples.trans: You can move right in and live here.
Drop by our place this evening.

examples.text: Можно сразу заезжать и жить. С мебелью мы тоже поможем.
examples.trans: You can move right in and live here. We'll help with the furniture too.

звонить.gloss: to call, to phone; to ring

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: For a door or a car.

examples.trans: The white one? Give me the keys.
Dad, put the crib together, please.
Can I go and have a look?
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: Два года назад = two years ago.

examples.text: Я их ещё два года назад им выделил!
examples.trans: I allocated it to them two years ago!

examples.text: Я их ещё два года назад им выделил! Я сам приказ подписывал!
examples.trans: I allocated it to them two years ago! I signed the order myself!

meanings.en: at the end, one last time, before leaving

examples.text: Виктор Петрович, я могу что-нибудь для вас сделать напоследок?
examples.trans: Viktor Petrovich, is there anything I can do for you before I go?
You know how it is, I need one last night out.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Она нашла нас на новом месте.
examples.trans: She found us at the new place.
That is it, she got really offended.
She is not answering her phone.

meanings.note: понимаешь? = you know? do you understand?

examples.trans: I want to go to the sea, you know?

examples.text: Я хочу нормально жить! Я хочу биде, понимаешь?
examples.trans: I want to live like a normal person! I want a bidet, do you understand?

meanings.note: Понял? = got it?; понял = got it.

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

meanings.en: a bit earlier, a little earlier

examples.trans: I decided to return home a bit earlier.
Let's wake up a bit earlier tomorrow.

meanings.note: to take a rest or sleep temporarily

examples.trans: Let us just sleep quietly tonight.
All right, let us just sleep tonight.

meanings.en: to try hard, do one's best

examples.trans: Try to manage without our help.
I will try to come on time.

examples.text: Постарайтесь обойтись без нашей помощи. — Спасибо вам огромное!
examples.trans: Try to manage without our help. — Thank you so much!

examples.text: Это правильно. Я приглашаю вас в общественный совет.
examples.trans: That's right. I'm inviting you onto the public council.
Security will be here any moment.

examples.text: Не надо, Самсон. Сейчас придёт охрана.
examples.trans: Don't, Samson. Security will be here any second.

meanings.note: работать + instrumental = to work as: работать мэром

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been working as mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

examples.text: Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.

examples.text: Виктор Степанович, сегодня никак не могу.
examples.trans: Viktor Stepanovich, I really can't today.

examples.text: Мэр куда-то спрятал деньги. Местные чиновники не могут собрать нужную сумму.
examples.trans: The mayor has hidden the money somewhere. The local officials can't put together the sum they need.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

examples.text: Максим, ступай, мне ещё работать надо.
examples.trans: Maxim, off you go, I still have work to do.

examples.text: Ступайте домой и отдохните как следует.
examples.trans: Go home and get a good rest.
The white one? Give me the keys.

examples.text: Не бросайте трубку, умоляю вас! Я перед вами стою на коленях.
examples.trans: Don't hang up, I'm begging you! I'm on my knees in front of you.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.en: to leave on foot, go away

examples.text: Какое хорошее утро! Лидия Алексеевна, чашку кофе, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: What a lovely morning! Lidia Alekseyevna, a cup of coffee, please.
If you don't want to, suit yourself.
They want to build a shopping centre there.

meanings.note: Дай хоть одну = give me just one.

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

час.governs: after 2, 3, 4 and полтора the genitive часа is stressed on the ending

meanings.note: В два часа = at two o'clock.
В два часа = at two o'clock.

examples.trans: I'll be there in an hour.

examples.text: Слушай, я уеду на полтора часа. Ты с Викой посиди, понял?
examples.trans: Listen, I'm going out for an hour and a half. You stay with Vika, got it?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: instrumental чем-то: чем-то помочь = help with something

examples.text: Так может быть, тебе надо чем-то помочь?
examples.trans: So maybe you need help with something?

meanings.note: Informal. Borrowed from French 'chef' (head, leader, from Latin 'caput'); in Russian kitchen culture 'шеф' is the standard form of address for the executive head chef.

examples.trans: The chef is in the kitchen.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
